type.description: Event type name managed from Admin → Tags & Categories → Event Types.

image_url.description: Optional cover image shown on the event list/card.

club_id.description: Owning club for club-scoped events (blank = community-wide event).

source_type.description: Optional originating feature, such as pota_activation or net_control.

source_id.description: ID of the originating POTA activation or Net Control session.

discord_event_id.description: The copy in the Discord server's Events tab ('removed' if a moderator deleted it there).

discord_synced_hash.description: Fingerprint of what was last sent to Discord, so unchanged edits aren't re-sent.

discord_notified_at.description: When the new-event message was posted to the Discord events channel.

club_owner_id.description: User id of the club owner (Club.created_by_id). Stamped at creation so the owner can manage this event via RLS.
